purpose: State an obligation casually by leaving its consequence understood.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I had better go home soon.
I have an early start tomorrow, so I need to sleep now.
I must reply before the deadline.
restrictions: Short for ないといけない or ないとだめ; context supplies the need.
mistake: This sentence-final use implies must; a full ないと-clause can also mean unless.
